### Nothing Left Unfinished
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-9-2025.html
Passage: Daniel 9:24
Points:
- True forgiveness and reconciliation with God only occur when Jesus is received as Messiah.
- God not only pardons sin through Christ but also grants believers His perfect righteousness.
- History moves according to God's purpose to fulfill every promise and prophecy He made.
- Believers can find peace knowing that God's decreed salvation and victory will be fully accomplished.

### Atoning for Iniquity
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/atoning-iniquity
Passage: Daniel 9:24-27
Points:
- Repeated Levitical sacrifices demonstrated that a greater, permanent solution to sin was still required.
- Gabriel reveals that seventy "sevens" must unfold before the full restoration and end of sin arrive.
- The cutting off of the Anointed One establishes a covenant that brings an end to old sacrificial rituals.
- Christ has accomplished final atonement, securing an age of everlasting righteousness for His people.
